article-meta.article-title: Archival Dispatch: 23 Master Broadcasts Dated Across James Stewart's Six Shooter, Jungle Jim, Gasoline Alley, and Dr. Paul
article-meta.kwd-group: The Six Shooter, James Stewart, Britt Ponset, Jungle Jim, Alex Raymond, Gasoline Alley, Frank King, Dr Paul, Russell Thorson, Soldiers of the Press, Ann Stringer, Asher and Little Jimmy, Original Filenames

sec.title: Batch 65 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 65 recovers and dates 23 historical radio broadcasts spanning Hollywood cinematic westerns, syndicated Sunday comic adaptations, WWII war correspondents, and classic daytime radio serials: James Stewart's celebrated NBC western masterpiece ***The Six Shooter*** (1953, starring Stewart as wandering frontier philosopher Britt Ponset), 6 high-action WWII jungle guerrilla episodes from ***Jungle Jim*** (1943, adapted from Alex Raymond's King Features Sunday comic strip), 5 garage comedy episodes from the radio adaptation of Frank King's comic strip ***Gasoline Alley*** (1941), 6 consecutive serialized episodes of the hit NBC daytime drama ***Dr. Paul*** (August 1952, starring Russell Thorson as Dr. Paul Henderson), 2 frontline combat dispatches from United Press war correspondents on ***Soldiers of the Press*** (1943–1945), and early country harmony pioneers ***Asher and Little Jimmy*** (1934).
